translation_notes: Context shim (_shim.py) restores is_before_rdflib, its _path_exists helper, and tests_dir from RDFLib/timefuncs@dd3bde8727 tests/test_is_before_standalone.py, since the region does not carry the function it exercises.

The 30 BEFORE.xNN accesses (namespace_term) translate one-for-one to prefixed names (before:xNN); the single namespace_ctor becomes @prefix ... as BEFORE, kept bound to BEFORE since only the prefix form is used inside the function body.
Harness-only addition (both sides, identical): the function only asserted and returned None, giving run_pair nothing to compare, so it now returns True on the line after all assertions pass.

repair.driver: En plus de l'appel run_pair (gardé), chaque côté est ré-exécuté avec is_before_rdflib remplacé, dans ses propres globales, par un enregistreur qui appelle la vraie fonction du shim et journalise (a, b, résultat), identique des deux côtés ; sont comparés le journal des 15 appels, l'issue, et le graphe de module g après coup (isomorphisme : is_before_rdflib y écrit des time:after). Fusionné dans le verdict de run_pair. Le `return True` seul ne voyait ni les termes des assertions négatives ni une assertion retirée.
repair.remaining: Mutant équivalent, non compté : before:a01 -> BEFORE.a01 (le `as BEFORE` lie le même Namespace). Aucune liaison de graphe en jeu (pas de @graph).

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the ten positive assertions become one loop over the pair numbers (`BEFORE["a" + n]`, `BEFORE["b" + n]`) and the five negative ones a loop over (a, b) local names, in the original order, so is_before_rdflib is called on the same pairs in the same sequence and the first failing assertion still raises AssertionError at the same pair (only the assertion's source line in the traceback differs). The harness `return True` and its comment are kept.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `@prefix before: <...> .` without `as` (the object is no longer needed), `before:a{n}`/`before:b{n}` for the computed local parts and `before:{a}`/`before:{b}` in the second loop. No exception to the symmetry rule. The driver's call recorder reads translated.ldpy only; the optimized artefacts keep the call sequence by construction.
header_optimization_notes: optimized_header.py: URIRef and BNode are unused: `from rdflib import Graph, Namespace` (Graph builds the module-level g the region reads).
optimized_header.ldpy: Namespace goes too (`@prefix` without `as`): `from rdflib import Graph`. The shim import and the module-level g stay on both sides.
